consequence.statement: Customization is optional; the default MRAP activating all managed resources (`*`) is created automatically and only affects cluster resource efficiency.

original.statement: Crossplane v2 automatically creates a default MRAP activating all managed resources (`*`); operators may optionally replace it with a targeted MRAP before installing v2 providers.

decision.reason: [ev-06a16cdbc869] says Crossplane v2 automatically creates a default MRAP that activates all managed resources (`*`). It describes replacing it with a targeted MRAP as optional, done "for better cluster resource efficiency". The excerpt says nothing fails, is rejected or stops being honoured if the operator does nothing. It also does not say that activation behaves differently from before, so P1's behavior-change claim is not supported. "none" (informational) matches the evidence.
